page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: a running head at the top centre, then three blocks side by side: a left column of Greek index words with page references, a middle column of Greek words with references, and a right column of references belonging to the middle column; below these, a letter "A." and the lower entries of the A-section. Right page: a narrow strip at the right edge with a running head, partly cut off, and marginal Greek words with numbers, which can only be read in part.
page.notes: The Greek words in the two left columns are hard to read at this scan resolution; several letters are uncertain and I have not marked each one with [?]. The numbers are as printed. The right-hand printed page is cut off at the scan edge and only fragments are legible: a running head "IND..." at the top, numbers such as 280.3, 280 and 27x, and a few Greek words in the margin (for example Μαθητε, μαθων, μακροθυμιαν), which I have not transcribed in full. The large initial at the bottom of the left page is a Greek Λ joined with the word Αβὲ.
